style_prefix: Painterly archival realism, warm amber and deep charcoal palette, soft documentary light, no text, no watermark, no identifiable faces, era- and region-accurate dress and landscape, vertical 9:16 composition with clear lower third for titles
negative: battle, war, weapons, soldiers, fantasy tropes, ethnic caricature, modern artifacts, vehicles, power lines, text, watermark, logo, photorealistic faces

scenes.brief: Yamnaya pastoralist camp at dawn on the Pontic steppe: round felt tents, grazing cattle, a family loading a wooden wagon for a seasonal move, vast grassland to the horizon
Anatolian farming village at harvest: mudbrick houses with flat roofs, villagers carrying grain baskets, terraced fields and olive trees in warm afternoon light
Bronze Age settlement workshop: craft workers casting bronze tools in clay molds beside timber longhouses, children watching, river and pine forest beyond
Medieval market town square on market day: timber-framed stalls with cloth and pottery, townsfolk trading, a stone church tower behind, autumn morning
Norse coastal hamlet at low tide: wooden longhouses, fishing boats pulled onto shingle, nets drying on racks, gulls over a grey northern sea
Caravanserai courtyard at dusk on a trade route: laden camels resting, merchants sharing bread around a fire, arched mudbrick galleries, desert hills beyond
Nineteenth-century harbor at departure time: a tall sailing ship at the quay, families with traveling trunks waving from the dock, gulls and morning mist
Highland croft at peat-cutting season: a stone cottage with a smoking chimney, stacked peat banks, sheep on the hill, low clouds and green moorland
Prairie homestead at golden hour: a timber farmhouse and barn, wheat fields to the horizon, a family walking home along a dirt track
Dark archival texture plate: deep charcoal background with faint antique map lines and star-chart geometry, subtle amber grain, empty center for monospaced type
Dark closing plate: near-black background with a soft warm vignette and faint compass-rose geometry, minimal, space in center for a wordmark and code
